messages:
sam: Hey team — I’m sam (joined last week). I see I was assigned to the on-call rotation starting Thu night. Quick questions: 1) I don’t have PagerDuty access yet, 2) the runbook for model-serving-high-latency links to a doc that gives me 403, and 3) who should I CC on escalations for customer-impacting issues? Also, would anyone be able to do a short pairing session for my first night shift?

oncall-bot: Reminder: new-rotation assignment for sam scheduled Thu 22:00-06:00 UTC. Please ensure PD and Okta groups are in place. If you need help, react with :wave:.

maya: Welcome, sam! For PagerDuty access file a ticket at https://intranet.redwood/case with team=eng-oncall and tag oc-access. Make sure your Okta profile has the `oncall-rotation` group; infra/admins will auto-provision PD after that. If you want me to check, ping me here.

devin: For who to CC: external-facing SEVs -> @support-ops + account CSM. Infrastructure/throughput incidents -> @eng-sre. For anything high-business-impact add @platform-leads. We try to keep cc lists minimal so folks can triage; if you're unsure, include one relevant group and @eng-oncall.

linh: Sam — that 403 is because the runbook is in the restricted docs space. I’ll grant view access to you now. Also the runbook has an outdated command — I’ll leave a note in the doc.

alex: I can pair for the first night shift. I’m available Wed 20:00-21:00 UTC or Thu 21:30-22:30 UTC for a 30m walkthrough. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood/meet/alex. I can show the PD flows, quick checks, and the escalation templates.

sam: Thanks! If you or maya can confirm PD access and doc perms before Wed evening that’d be great. One extra quick question — for the model fallback in the runbook, is the step to switch to the quantized replica automated or manual? I want to rehearse it during pairing.

maya: The fallback is manual today (toggle in the console + restart routing service). We have a runbook snippet to follow. Quick checklist I use when paged for high-latency:```- Check console: route health and queue length
- Run `rws status --model model-serving` to confirm instance health
- If healthy nodes < 2 and latency > 2000ms -> enable fallback: console -> routing -> switch variant -> confirm tail latency drops
- If customer impact, page support-ops and CC account CSM
- If uncertain, escalate to eng-sre after 15m```

devin: One more admin note: I’ll add sam to the PagerDuty escalation policy for the rotation (so you get on-call SMS/push). Also I’ll tag the PD policy to include @platform-leads as a second-level escalation for business-impact incidents.

linh: Done — sam has view on the runbook and I added you to the doc editors group so you can comment. Also added you to Okta `oncall-rotation` (should propagate in ~5m). Confirm once you can access PD. :thumbsup:

sam: I can see the runbook now and got the PD invite. Thanks everyone — I’ll join Alex for the Wed 20:00 walkthrough. Appreciate the quick help!
